evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process or any questions you'd like to ask first' — asked after full probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'No... they used movers before, so it's pretty straightforward' — no concern raised, full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'This is only my estimate, if ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we use' (pay-less line) + 'if you have disassembled some of the furniture... that would really help keep the time down... the less time we take, the less money you end up spending' (self-prep tip) — two distinct Save Your Ass lines used.

top_strength: Best Save Your Ass execution in the batch — explicitly connected customer self-prep to a lower bill, and used a creative 'school bus lengths' technique to nail down an exact walking distance.
coaching_note: Still missing the Sheet 1/2 differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) and the Stage 2 takeaway entirely — good value-building in Stage 3 isn't being backed up by any trust-building in Stage 1/2.
